title: Polynomial-Time Computability of Header Indices
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, each of the following functions is polynomial-time computable in unary: the initial residual ordinal, the state residual ordinal, the input residual ordinal, the work residual ordinal, and the accept residual ordinal extracted from a word.
replaced: For every source machine, the unary residual ordinals of all five families, after the pins, for the state family, the input family, the work family, and the accept family, are polynomial-time computable by native unary arithmetic on stored words.
